name: libjwt
scope: bounded local-JWKS parsing and compact asymmetric JWT verification for the shard-local route authentication path

patches.purpose: Reject duplicate JWKS object members and embedded-NUL JSON strings before JOSE comparison or key lookup

sanitizer_compiler_note.treatment: retained as a warning, but not promoted to an error, for the instrumented LibJWT build only
sanitizer_compiler_note.reason: LibJWT's bounded error-copy macro copies at most sizeof(error_msg)-1 bytes and explicitly terminates the destination; GCC 13 emits the warning only in the optimized sanitizer build

review.decision: accepted for the Phase 3 bounded local-JWKS checkpoint after correctness, sanitizer, static-analysis, SBOM, and vulnerability qualification

local_qualification.note: The accepted boundary uses bounded file-backed public JWKS material and performs no request-time network access; remote retrieval and live atomic key rotation remain separate Phase 4 work.

remaining_gates: measure JWT feature cost on dedicated native hardware before performance publication
remote JWKS retrieval and atomic key rotation remain Phase 4 control-plane work
